text: function returns tibble describing corresponding component database. files_download() returns character() vector paths local files. links() returns tibble external links associated collection. Common links includ DOI, raw data / data sources, lab websites. authors() returns tibble authors associated collection. publisher_metadata() returns tibble publisher metadata (journal, publicate date, doi) associated collection.
